column3: Explain basic AI concepts and intended use
Interpret AI output in clinical context
Explain sensitivity specificity false positives and false negatives
Recognise uncertainty limitations and ungradable inputs
Challenge unsupported or inconsistent AI recommendations
Recognise potential population and data biases
Apply escalation and human review procedures
Explain AI involvement and limitations clearly
Report and escalate suspected AI-related incidents
Interpret performance and safety monitoring information
Support multidisciplinary learning and safe adoption
Maintain competence after system or pathway changes
